parsed.scene_description: The image shows a modern library with a large circular display in the center. The display is made up of multiple layers of books arranged in a spiral-like pattern. The books are of different sizes and colors, and they are stacked on top of each other in a neat and orderly manner. The library has large windows that let in natural light and offer a view of the outside. There are several tables and chairs scattered throughout the space, and a few people can be seen walking around. The overall atmosphere of the library is bright and airy.
